skills.name: personal-ops
skills.description: Orchestrate personal digital-life work that spans two or more domains, resolve authority and current state first, then route the smallest sufficient actions without silently crossing permission boundaries.

skills.name: communications
skills.description: Manage personal Gmail and contacts: search/read messages, triage action, resolve recipients, prepare/send replies, and track follow-up while preserving draft/sent state.

skills.name: calendar
skills.description: Manage personal calendar events, availability, deadlines, reminders, recurring obligations, invitations, and conflicts using current calendar state.

skills.name: files
skills.description: Manage personal files across ChatGPT Library and Google Drive: retrieval, custody, naming, provenance, duplicates, organization, and safe lifecycle operations.

skills.name: finances
skills.description: Manage and analyze personal financial data: linked-account coverage, transactions, cash flow, bills, subscriptions, liabilities, holdings, and account-sync state without inventing missing coverage.

skills.name: accounts
skills.description: Manage digital account lifecycle: inventory, subscription state, authentication and recovery readiness, permissions, reconnection, cancellation, and closure boundaries without storing secrets.

skills.name: social-media
skills.description: Manage personal social-media publishing and archive: topic inventory, exact post text, draft versus published state, provenance, cross-platform reuse, and recovery of incomplete history.

skills.name: devices
skills.description: Manage personal Android/Termux/device hygiene: storage, apps, permissions, updates, backups, non-destructive debloat, device-access boundaries, and recovery readiness.

skills.name: personal-admin
skills.description: Manage personal administrative obligations such as taxes, benefits, insurance, legal/civic paperwork, official deadlines, receipts, evidence packets, and submission state.

skills.name: personal-github
skills.description: Manage personal GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, profile surfaces, publication state, and strict separation from organization-owned authority and canon.

skills.name: automation
skills.description: Manage personal reminders, recurring scans, scheduled briefings, condition watches, and automation lifecycle while preventing duplicate or stale tasks.

skills.name: digital-continuity
skills.description: Manage backups, exports, migration, recovery paths, data survivability, and failure-safe access to important personal digital state without centralizing secrets.
